description: This file defines the EasyHandle class, which represents a cURL easy handle used internally by GuzzleHttp's handler system. It manages request and response data, headers, and errors for HTTP requests.

classes.name: EasyHandle
classes.description: Represents a cURL easy handle and the data it populates during HTTP requests.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Attaches a Response object to the handle based on received headers, parsing header data and handling content encoding.
